name: blink-connectors
description: Use every app you connect in Blink Connectors (Gmail, GitHub, Notion, Slack and more) from Claude Code through one MCP server.

key.title: Blink Connectors project key
key.description: Open a project at https://connectors.blinkbrosai.com/app and copy its key (starts with sk_).

user.title: Your user id
user.description: Any stable id for you, such as your email. Accounts you connect are saved under this id.
